memory.note: Verified 2026-09-05 on this machine: `claude --help` lists `--add-dir <directories...>`, `--append-system-prompt`, `--model` and `--dangerously-skip-permissions`; ~/.claude/projects/ held 48 project directories with a memory/ subdirectory, keyed by the absolute cwd with every / and . replaced by -.

bootstrap_message: Read {{bootstrap_file}} and follow it exactly. Reply with the single word READY once you have read it and every skill it lists.
notes: Models: fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, or a full model id. Memory is keyed by working directory, so an agent given its own cwd gets its own memory and keeps it across spawns; --add-dir grants tool access to the repo it actually works in. Set auto_approve: true on the agent to add --dangerously-skip-permissions.
